uplift_thesis: More clips is not the same thing as a stronger roof. A metal roof resists wind as a complete tested assembly -- panel profile, seam, clip, fastener and deck together -- and the number that measures it is the tested design pressure in PSF. Tightening clip spacing adds attachment points, but the assembly with the most clips below is not the one with the highest tested pressure.
